create_video_class: create a Video instance to open a video file and extract frames by index
open_video_file: open a video file with the Video class using cv2 VideoCapture and validate the path
extract_frames_by_index: extract specific frames from an opened video by providing a list of frame indices
count_video_frames: count the total number of frames in an opened video using cv2 CAP_PROP_FRAME_COUNT
create_videoiter_dataset: create a VideoIter PyTorch Dataset from a video prefix directory and a text list file
